description: This PHP class 'AdminSdgEditForm' is part of the Goteo project, handling the form creation and processing for editing Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the administrative interface. It manages form fields for name, description, icon, and associated footprints, and includes logic for validation, saving, and updating SDG data.

classes.name: AdminSdgEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating and saving the SDG (Sustainable Development Goal) editing form in the admin panel, allowing admins to modify SDG attributes like name, description, icon, and associated footprints.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for form fields, enforcing non-blank values for certain inputs.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the form with fields for name, description, icon upload, and footprint selection, populating choices from the Footprint list.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes form data to update the SDG model, handling image uploads and footprint associations.
